summary: Complete jet-drive waveguide flute physical model with 8 presets, impossible physics, tone holes, and full MIDI/MPE support.

required.note: Main processor with 8-voice synth, MIDI/MPE, oversampling
Per-voice DSP: jet exciter, bore waveguide, 2x oversampling
renderNextBlock with full physical model loop
Breath pressure p^1.5, turbulence noise, vibrato LFO
DC blocker in feedback loop (0.995 coefficient)
Bidirectional Thiran allpass delay, end reflection, radiation filter
8 presets: Concert Flute, Shakuhachi, Bansuri, Native Am., Recorder, Pan Flute, Piccolo, Ocarina
Build config with tuning module, WebView2 static linking

decisions.decision: Each voice owns its own Oversampling<float> instance rather than shared post-mix oversampling
decisions.rationale: Physical model feedback loop needs oversampling inside the loop to prevent aliasing in nonlinear jet processing
alternatives: Post-mix oversampling (simpler but aliasing in feedback loop)
4x oversampling (better quality but CPU heavy for 8 voices)

decisions.decision: Use DelayLine<float, Thiran> for fractional-sample bore delay
decisions.rationale: Thiran allpass preserves phase accuracy at fractional delays, critical for pitch accuracy in waveguide models

decisions.decision: Tier 2 tone holes implemented but enabled=false by default
decisions.rationale: CPU cost of 8 scattering junctions is significant; enable via preset or UI toggle in Stage 3

keyInformation: 16 APVTS parameters: BREATH_PRESSURE, EMBOUCHURE, OVERBLOW, JET_NOISE, VIBRATO_RATE, VIBRATO_DEPTH, BORE_LENGTH, AIR_COLUMN, INFINITE_SUSTAIN, REVERSED_JET, SUB_HARMONICS, WIDTH, TONE_HOLES_ENABLE, INSTRUMENT_PRESET, TUNING_SYSTEM, REFERENCE_PITCH
Preset selection via std::atomic<int> currentPresetIndex — needs UI selector
ToneHoleSystem.enabled defaults false — needs UI toggle or preset-based activation
CC/MPE mapping: CC2->breath, CC74->embouchure, CC1->vibrato, pitch bend +/-2 semitones
Build verified: ninja O-Wind_VST3 O-Wind_AU, pluginval strictness 10, auval all pass
3 impossible physics params (INFINITE_SUSTAIN, REVERSED_JET, SUB_HARMONICS) need prominent UI placement
